message.content:
I changed the copy constructor to move the two byte vectors out of the source instead of deep-copying them, eliminating a heap allocation, memcpy, and free for every copied field. In the decode path the source is a short-lived temporary that is never read again, so the stored field values (and thus the checksum) are identical.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).values)),
      stringIndexes(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).stringIndexes))
{
}
```
